frequency_question: How often do such announced measures actually take effect on schedule without being delayed, rescinded, or replaced by a negotiated agreement prior to the deadline?
membership_rule: Includes official executive announcements of major tariff or sanction implementations with hard effective dates; excludes voluntary trade policy adjustments without prior threat of unilateral imposition.

coverage_note: 7 notable announced unilateral tariff actions or major threats with fixed implementation schedules examined; 5 implemented on schedule, 2 averted or replaced by agreement before the deadline.
